reading.nl: My father works in a bank, and my mother is a cook.

reading.pr: مای فادِر وِرکس این اِ بَنک، اَند مای مادِر ایز اِ کوک.

reading.nl: I have two sisters and one brother.

reading.pr: آی هَو تو سیستِرز اَند وان برادِر.

reading.nl: My brother is ten years old.

reading.nl: My grandmother lives with us. She is very kind.
